# Terraform style guide (HashiCorp)

Write Terraform that follows HashiCorp's official style, naming and file layout.

- Source: https://github.com/hashicorp/agent-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hashicorp/agent-skills/main/plugins/terraform/skills/terraform-style-guide/SKILL.md
- Author: HashiCorp
- License: MPL-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/terraform-style-guide-hashicorp-0a4fb6c9

Applied when writing, reviewing or generating Terraform. It covers file organization (terraform.tf, variables, locals, main, outputs), formatting, naming conventions, variable and output design, and security defaults, with good and bad examples throughout.

**Try asking:**
- "Write Terraform for an S3 bucket with versioning, following best practices"
- "Review this module against HashiCorp style"
- "Clean up the naming in our Terraform files"

**Source:** [hashicorp/agent-skills](https://github.com/hashicorp/agent-skills/tree/HEAD/plugins/terraform/skills/terraform-style-guide) · MPL-2.0 · by HashiCorp
